en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional. 'Слуга' here is feminine, a serving girl, as the song makes clear (my reading). 'Ладна меана' is a cool/cold tavern.

lines.cyr: ќе ми одат на ладна меана,
lines.lat: ḱe mi odat na ladna meana,
lines.en: they will go to the cold tavern,

lines.cyr: ќе ми пијат вино, ем ракија.
lines.lat: ḱe mi pijat vino, em rakija.
lines.en: they will drink wine and brandy.
The girl Anusha serves as a maid, dear,

lines.cyr: слуга служи, за рака ја фаќаат.
lines.lat: sluga služi, za raka ja faḱaat.
lines.en: she serves, they grab her by the hand.
- I serve as a maid, I do not become a lover.

lines.cyr: Љуба сум си само на едного, џанам,
lines.lat: Ljuba sum si samo na ednogo, džanam,
lines.en: I am a lover only to one, dear,

lines.cyr: што го носи фесчето над око,
lines.lat: što go nosi fesčeto nad oko,
lines.en: who wears his fez over his eye,

lines.cyr: а мене ме гледа испод око.
lines.lat: a mene me gleda ispod oko.
lines.en: and looks at me from under his eye.
